entries.summary: With a hardware keyboard, Return now sends your message and Command-Return adds a new line; choose Command-Return to send instead in Settings, Chats, Send With.
While a reply is running, Control-Return on a hardware keyboard queues your message, or steers the reply when your messages normally queue.
A message with attached files sent while a reply is running now waits in the queue with its files, instead of steering the reply with the text and leaving the files behind.
